description: ABB Process Performance IE4 induction motors are engineered to the highest standards to deliver superior reliability and efficiency. Built with a cast iron frame, high-tensile steel shafts, and precision bearings, these reliable motors minimize wear and extend lifespan.
differentiators: Class F insulation with standard PTC temperature sensors

description: SIMOTICS SD (Severe Duty) IE4 motors are highly robust cast-iron motors for use in severe industrial environments. Compliant with IE4 super premium efficiency class, they offer high efficiency, reliability, an attractive design, low noise, and minimal vibration.

W22 IE4 Super Premium cast iron induction motors offer high efficiency with DOL or VFD operation. With a cast iron frame, flexible mounting, solid and whole feet, and lower noise levels and operating temperatures, the W22 motors are perfectly suitable for a great variety of industrial applications.
differentiators: Lower operating temperatures and noise levels
